An invented post, long enough to show a post's page: its date, its project, its sections with their trailing vines, and the specimen card at its end. Real posts come from the vault and are never committed here.

## Why a sample garden

Invented words about why anyone would plant a garden of samples. The garden exists only so that the tests have somewhere to walk, and every plant in it is labelled as invented.

More invented words, so that the page is tall enough for the vine beside it to have something to hang next to.

## What grew

Invented words about what grew in it. Nothing grew, of course: the samples stay exactly as they were planted, which is the point of them.
